mentions.description: A free, UETA and ESIGN compliant e-signature tool offering unlimited free document signing as a low-cost alternative to DocuSign, built in a weekend for under $50.
mentions.problem: DocuSign and similar e-signature services are expensive, so the author built a free alternative.
mentions.audience: Businesses seeking a free alternative to DocuSign
mentions.source_excerpt: In about a weekend, I built a UETA and ESIGN compliant tool. And it was free. And it cost me less than $50. Unlimited free e-sign. https://useinkless.com/
